_comment: Single source of truth for the forward camera. model.sdf must match (tested in ros2_ws/src/maverick_bridge/test/test_camera_pose.py). xyz in metres and rpy in radians give the Gazebo sensor frame (x forward, y left, z up) relative to base_link (FLU body, origin at the centre of mass). The optical frame (z forward, x right, y down) is derived from it by maverick_bridge.camera_pose.
